title: Local preview build, sample content and tests
description: `bin/build_local_site.py` renders `sample-content/` (the design's bracketed placeholder copy, in the CMS layout) through the real projector into `web/dist-local`. `tests/test_projector.py` (13 tests) covers page set, lead and hero selection, inline signup placement, dependency digests, redirects and escaping. Verified with Playwright at 1440 and 390 px; filters, deep links, prefill and the closed-signup notice exercised in a browser.
